entries.content: F2P Primogem guide 2026: priority build strong character trước → sau optimize farming. Daily: commissions (60 primo), resin management. Weekly: domains, boss oculi, time trials. Events: limited time — grab all rewards. Achievement: secret không nhiều người biết. Key insight: chơi game chứ không phải farming máy.

entries.content: Primogem farming F2P: daily activities (commissions, events), weekly activities (domains, oculi, bosses), storyline quests, achievement hunting. Không có farming 'efficient' — chơi game là chính, farming là phụ. Strong character trước khi focus farming. Weekly routine: daily commissions 60, event boss 300-600, domain farming 200-400, oculi softmax 160, storyline completion.

Daily login 1 phút → 10 Primogem. Daily Commissions 60 Primogem/ngày (10/prém). Event rewards 45 phút countdown — đợi hết mới nhận tránh lãng phí. Extreme quests, character stories, bounty hunting, achievement hunting là nguồn Primogem lớn. Nâng Reputation level để được Treasure Compass + Elemental Resonance Stone. Time trials weekly. Co-op: boss kill rate 100% chỉ cho character của mình, boss loot không shared, currency stored jointly.
